This repository is a **read-only mirror**. Its entire contents are replaced on every
release, so a pull request merged here would be overwritten and lost.

It exists so npm can attest build provenance for the `superslate` package against
public source. The bootstrapper is developed elsewhere.

Bug reports and questions are genuinely welcome — please
[open an issue](https://github.com/superslate-dev/superslate-cli/issues) instead.
